Container.Name: agentmemory
Container.Overview: Cross-session memory layer for coding agents. Self-contained multi-arch container (iii engine v0.11.2 + agentmemory worker). Bring your own LLM and embedding provider: Gemini, OpenAI, any OpenAI-compatible API (DeepSeek, Z.ai GLM, SiliconFlow, vLLM, Ollama), Anthropic, MiniMax, or OpenRouter. Bearer-authenticated REST + viewer. Persistent state in /data.
Container.Requires: Set at least ONE LLM provider key below (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, MiniMax, or OpenRouter). Without one the container runs BM25-only with LLM features disabled. Cloud embeddings are mandatory in this image (local is omitted). To open the viewer from a browser, set AGENTMEMORY_SECRET and VIEWER_ALLOWED_HOSTS. Put migrated state_store.db + stream_store into the appdata dir BEFORE first start.

Config.Name: REST / MCP HTTP
Config.Description: REST API + MCP HTTP surface. Clients set AGENTMEMORY_URL=http://<NAS-IP>:3111

Config.Name: Viewer WebUI
Config.Description: Memory browser UI. LAN-reachable only when VIEWER_ALLOWED_HOSTS is set; otherwise stays loopback (local-only). Auth-gated by AGENTMEMORY_SECRET via a built-in login modal.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent KV store: state_store.db, stream_store, .hmac, snapshots. Put on the cache pool. Covered by Appdata Backup.

Config.Name: Bearer Secret
Config.Description: Auth secret for REST + viewer. The viewer shows a login modal that asks for this. Set once, reuse on every client. If left blank a random one is generated on first boot (read it from the container log).

Config.Name: Viewer Allowed Hosts
Config.Description: Set to enable LAN access to the viewer web UI. Comma-separated Host:port values a browser will use, e.g. whitebox:3113 or 192.168.1.10:3113 (exact match, no wildcards). Leave blank to keep the viewer loopback-only (published 3113 unreachable from LAN, container stays healthy).

Config.Name: LLM: Gemini API Key
Config.Description: Google Gemini key. Powers LLM (compress/consolidation/graph) + embeddings. Default provider. Get one at aistudio.google.com/apikey.

Config.Name: LLM: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: OpenAI key, OR any OpenAI-compatible provider when paired with OPENAI_BASE_URL (DeepSeek, Z.ai GLM, SiliconFlow, vLLM, LM Studio, Ollama). Powers LLM + embeddings.

Config.Name: LLM: OpenAI Base URL
Config.Description: Override endpoint for OpenAI-compatible providers. Examples: https://api.deepseek.com/v1 (DeepSeek), https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4 (Z.ai GLM), https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1 (SiliconFlow), http://host.docker.internal:1234/v1 (LM Studio), http://ollama:11434/v1 (Ollama). Leave blank for OpenAI itself.

Config.Name: LLM: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Anthropic key. LLM only (Anthropic has no embeddings API; you must also set an embedding provider key such as Gemini or OpenAI).

Config.Name: LLM: MiniMax API Key
Config.Description: MiniMax key. LLM only (no embeddings). Pair with an embedding provider.

Config.Name: LLM: OpenRouter API Key
Config.Description: OpenRouter key. One key reaches many models (DeepSeek, GLM, Claude, GPT, etc.) for LLM + embeddings. Easiest multi-model route.

Config.Name: Embedding Provider
Config.Description: Leave blank to auto-detect from your keys (Gemini > OpenAI > Voyage > Cohere > OpenRouter). Or force one: gemini, openai, voyage, cohere, openrouter. NOTE: local is unavailable in this image (the transformers dependency is omitted), so a cloud provider is mandatory.

Config.Name: Embeddings: Voyage API Key
Config.Description: Voyage AI key. Optimised for code embeddings. Used when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=voyage (or auto-detected).

Config.Name: Embeddings: Cohere API Key
Config.Description: Cohere key for general-purpose embeddings. Used when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=cohere (or auto-detected).

Config.Name: MCP Tool Surface
Config.Description: Tools exposed to MCP clients. core = 7 essential tools (default); all = 51 tools. Bump to all for power-user clients.

Config.Name: Gemini Model
Config.Description: Gemini LLM model. gemini-3.5-flash-lite is non-thinking and avoids burst stream drops. gemini-2.5-flash-lite is retired by Google (404 for new users) and must not be used.

Config.Name: Anthropic Model
Config.Description: Anthropic model id. Examples: claude-sonnet-4-5, claude-haiku-4-5, claude-opus-4-1. Use a current id.

Config.Name: Anthropic Base URL
Config.Description: Override for Anthropic-compatible proxies or Azure AI Foundry. Leave blank for api.anthropic.com.

Config.Name: MiniMax Model
Config.Description: MiniMax model id. Example: MiniMax-M2.

Config.Name: OpenRouter Model
Config.Description: OpenRouter model slug. Examples: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5, deepseek/deepseek-chat, zhipuai/glm-4.6, openai/gpt-4.1.

Config.Name: OpenAI Embedding Model
Config.Description: Embedding model when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai. Default text-embedding-3-small. Also honored by OpenAI-compatible providers that expose /v1/embeddings.

Config.Name: OpenAI Embedding Dimensions
Config.Description: Required only when the embedding model is not in agentmemory's known-models table. Leave blank otherwise.

Config.Name: Max Tokens
Config.Description: Cap on LLM completion tokens for compression / summarise calls.

Config.Name: LLM Timeout (ms)
Config.Description: Outbound LLM / embedding request timeout, shared across all raw-fetch providers (Gemini, OpenRouter, MiniMax, OpenAI, Cohere, Voyage).

Config.Name: Fallback Providers
Config.Description: Comma-separated provider chain tried after the primary returns an error (e.g. a rate limit). Example: anthropic,gemini. Order matters.

Config.Name: Auto Compress
Config.Description: Run LLM compression on every observation batch (needs a provider key). Default on; synthetic compression runs when off.

Config.Name: Inject Context
Config.Description: Inject recalled memories into agent prompts at session start.

Config.Name: Consolidation
Config.Description: 4-tier consolidation pipeline (working, episodic, semantic, procedural) + decay.

Config.Name: Graph Extraction
Config.Description: Extract concept-graph edges on remember; powers graph-traversal recall.

Config.Name: Decay Days
Config.Description: Age in days after which non-reinforced memories decay during consolidation. Upstream default 30.

Config.Name: Reflect (auto-lessons)
Config.Description: Periodically auto-synthesize lessons from memories.

Config.Name: Graph Batch Size
Config.Description: Memories processed per graph-extraction batch.

Config.Name: Max Obs/Session
Config.Description: Per-session observation cap before consolidation triggers. Upstream default 500.

Config.Name: Drop Stale Index
Config.Description: Recovery toggle: drop on-disk BM25 / vector index on startup if the dimension guard fires. Enable once to recover from a stuck index, then turn off.

Config.Name: Image Embeddings (experimental)
Config.Description: Enable image embeddings when an image-capable provider is present. Experimental.

Config.Name: BM25 Weight
Config.Description: Hybrid search weight for the BM25 (keyword) leg.

Config.Name: Vector Weight
Config.Description: Hybrid search weight for the vector (semantic) leg.

Config.Name: Graph Weight
Config.Description: Graph-traversal bonus on smart-search ranking.

Config.Name: Context Token Budget
Config.Description: Max tokens injected via mem::context per session.

Config.Name: Summarize Chunk Size
Config.Description: Observations per chunk when summarising large (e.g. imported) sessions.

Config.Name: Summarize Chunk Concurrency
Config.Description: Parallel chunk LLM calls during chunked summarise. Bump for large imports on high-throughput providers.

Config.Name: Snapshots Enabled
Config.Description: Periodic snapshots of state_store + stream_store for point-in-time backup/restore.

Config.Name: Snapshot Dir
Config.Description: Where snapshots are written. Keep under /data so they land on the persistent appdata volume.

Config.Name: Snapshot Interval (s)
Config.Description: Seconds between snapshots.

Config.Name: Team Mode
Config.Description: Set to shared to scope memories to (TEAM_ID, USER_ID) tuples for multi-user deployments. Leave blank for single-user.

Config.Name: Team ID
Config.Description: Team identifier when TEAM_MODE=shared. Example: home, acme.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: User identifier within the team when TEAM_MODE=shared.
